The Difference

Most Companies Install Metal Roofs. We Build Them.

Here is how it usually works. A crew shows up with panels ordered weeks earlier, cut to a rough measurement in someone else’s warehouse. When something does not line up, they trim it, overlap it, and cover the gap with caulk and extra trim. It holds for a while. Then the caulk fails.

We do not work that way.

TopLine Pro Construction owns an Englert rollforming machine. We bring it to your property and form every panel on site, cut to the exact dimension of the run it is going on. Every hip, dormer, chimney, and rake edge gets flashing bent and fitted to that specific detail, not pulled off a shelf.

The result is a roof that seals the way a standing seam system is engineered to seal, with lines that stay straight across the whole elevation. That second part is what people notice from the street.

On-site fabrication

We form our own panels

The Englert machine is ours. No outside fabricator marking up material and adding two weeks to your schedule. That savings goes to you, not to a supplier’s margin.

Measured on your roof

We cut on site, not in a warehouse

Panels are measured off your actual roof and formed the same day they go up. No transport damage, no wrong lengths, no forcing a piece to fit.

Valleys, eaves, ridges

We finish what nobody inspects

Valleys, eaves, ridges, and penetrations are where metal roofs leak and where they look cheap. On our jobs those get the most attention, not the least.

50+ Years Zero Exposed Fasteners Sheds Snow & Ice Almost No Maintenance

We are not the cheapest bid you will get. We are the one you will not have to call back.

If you are collecting bids, put ours next to the others and ask each company one question: who is fabricating the metal, and who is on the roof? The answers will tell you more than the price does.
